newsitem.title: UK: Virgin Express in talks to buy Air Liberte - paper.
newsitem.headline: Virgin Express in talks to buy Air Liberte - paper.

text.p: Virgin Express, Richard Branson's European short-haul airline, is in talks to buy Air Liberte, the French regional carrier that recently went into administration, the Financial Times reported on Friday.
The newspaper quoted Branson as saying that Virgin Express was in talks to buy Air Liberte assets, as well as its take-off and landing slots in France.

Virgin Express had said earlier this month it was in talks with several airlines, but declined at the time to confirm specific proposals. Industry sources, however, had already said Virgin was eyeing Air Liberte.
